text_excerpt: Profile --> Regina Hayburn, DVM, DACVIM (oncology) Texas A&M College of Veterinary Medicine , Oncology Studies Evaluating whole abdomen radiation therapy as a treatment for feline small cell gastrointestinal lymphoma Help us determine if whole abdomen radiation therapy helps cats with small cell gastrointestinal lymphoma Evaluating whole abdomen radiation therapy as a treatment for feline small cell gastrointestinal lymphoma Help us determine if whole abdomen radiation therapy helps cats with small cell gastrointestinal lymphoma This study will evaluate how well-tolerated whole abdomen radiation is for cats diagnosed with small cell lymphoma. The goal of this study is to establish a safe and practical radiation protocol and to monitor treatment response in cats with gastrointestinal small cell lymphoma (i.e., cancer involving the stomach or intestines).
